text:
mike: Heads up — after last night's microcode patch on racks in us-west-3 several OOB BMCs flipped to an unexpected boot state: 'secureboot: unknown'. KVM serials dropping intermittently.
ana: Which racks/nodes? Are GPUs getting evicted?
jess: infra-monitor: eviction_rate 0.034 -> triggered alert. Queue backlog up 18% in us-west-3-gpu pools.
infra-monitor-bot: Alert: oob_bootstate_unexpected (id: oob-179555). Affected BMCs: 7. GPU evictions increased by 32%. See /dashboards/oob/usw3
raj: Pause the microcode rollout ASAP. Canary groups only; we need a rollback plan. @deploy-bot can you hold further batches?
deploy-bot: Holding rollout for microcode_v3.1.2. No further batches scheduled.
mike: I pulled a quick list: rack-r3-{02,05,09,11}. Running `ipmitool -I lanplus -H $BMC -U admin -P **** chassis power status` shows correct power but `ipmitool mc info` returns 'secureboot: unknown' on 4 nodes.
ana: Can we repro locally on a test board? Also need eviction logs from kube-scheduler for those nodes.
jess: Pasted the eviction log snippet:
```
I0312 02:14:05.123 kubelet evicting pod "training-job-42" due to node.kubelet.eviction
reason="KubeletOutOfResource"
```
jess: Cost note: fallback to on-demand GPUs + rerouted traffic estimated +$4k/day until we stabilize.
raj: Ops plan: 1) pause rollout (done). 2) rollback microcode on affected racks to v3.1.0. 3) run `redwood-oobctl inspect --bmc rack-r3-05 --fields bootstate,serial`. 4) run canary verification: 3x successful KVM connect.
mike: I'll run the rollback for rack-r3-02 and 05 now (manual per runbook). Posting run commands:
```
redwood-deploy rollback --component bmc-mc --target rack-r3-02 --version 3.1.0
redwood-deploy rollback --component bmc-mc --target rack-r3-05 --version 3.1.0
```
deploy-bot: Rollback jobs queued (job-7891, job-7892). ETA ~12m per rack.
ana: I'll coordinate GPU scheduler to avoid placing new pods on these racks until we confirm.
jess: I'll open an incident ticket and link telemetry: https://infra.redwood.internal/incident/RED-179555
mike: Thanks — keep updates in this thread. After rollback we'll re-run the canary (rack-r3-09) and only then continue.
raj: Post-mortem owner assigned: jess. Please capture timeline and cost impact.
mike: :thumbsup:
